articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin falls below $66,000 as SpaceX rallies on Cursor agreement
articles.snippet: Ether, XRP, Solana and Hyperliquid funds all took in money, but bitcoin's outflow was really just Grayscale's GBTC.

articles.title: Anthropic shutdown makes a strong case for decentralized AI: Grayscale
articles.snippet: Grayscale says decentralized AI tokens gained after the US government ordered Anthropic to cut access to its latest AI models, showing user demand for alternatives to centralized AI.
